purpose: Seed benchmark set for measuring ID <-> EN translation quality before claiming Gemini-class readiness.

scoring.pass_rule: No product-class claim until average quality score is >= 4.3/5 and p95 latency is reported from target PC.

seed_cases.source: Tolong tunggu sebentar, saya sedang menyiapkan file presentasinya.
seed_cases.expected_meaning: Please wait a moment while I prepare the presentation file.

seed_cases.source: Apakah rapat hari ini bisa dipindahkan ke jam yang sama besok?
seed_cases.expected_meaning: Can today's meeting be moved to the same time tomorrow?

seed_cases.source: Let us know if you are available today.
seed_cases.expected_meaning: Beri tahu kami jika Anda tersedia hari ini.

seed_cases.source: Aplikasi belum merespons setelah tombol mikrofon ditekan.
seed_cases.expected_meaning: The app has not responded after the microphone button was pressed.

readiness_rule: Benchmark existence is not runtime proof. Scores must come from local target-PC execution.
